title: OpaComplianceInput
description: The `input` document passed to OPA when evaluating any `usda.policy.*` Rego module. Callers supply organizational context and a flat map of requirement-ID → attestation booleans. Any requirement ID absent from `assertions` is treated as unattested (false), generating a violation.

organization.description: Organizational context used by the `directive_applies` rule.

agency.description: Must be 'USDA'. The `directive_applies` rule evaluates to true only when this value is present and equals 'USDA'.

office.description: Optional sub-agency or mission area abbreviation (e.g. 'OCIO', 'AMS', 'FSA').

system_name.description: Optional name of the system or program being evaluated for compliance.

assertions.description: Flat map of requirement ID → boolean attestation. A value of `true` means the evaluating organization asserts it meets that requirement. A value of `false` or an absent key means non-compliance, producing a violation entry.
